objective: Implement client network-health telemetry and selected server request-ID correlation from communication review finding3.
behavior: Signed-in, capability-negotiated first-party observations; network_schema_version1. Existing/disabled servers are not probed and queued diagnostics are deferred unchanged.

Fixed categories, method/status/error counts, success/cancellation/retry/throttling, total/client-queue/preparation/HTTP/decode timing and latency buckets. HTTP429 counts remain visible even when the body is invalid.
Request sizes are encoded attempted body sizes; response sizes are returned decoded body sizes. Headers, TLS, radio cost, SDK traffic and telemetry transport itself are excluded.
New race jobs retain a server-time queue anchor; known upload age is sampled without inferring old/malformed/unanchored records. File/replay preparation is measured outside canonical simulation.

Safe UUIDv4 request IDs survive headers or bounded JSON metadata and are returned to callers; latest selected failure kinds retain correlation hints without URLs, bodies, credentials, raw operation keys or arbitrary error text.

RAM counters are separated by account/origin, bounded to4 scopes,16 categories,128 operation entries and8 selected failure kinds per scope. Unsnapshotted state expires after24h and can be lost on process termination or scope eviction.

Menu-time snapshots are due every5minutes. No diagnostic snapshot/disk worker/upload begins during driving. Existing1000-event/2MiB/50-event/64KiB/24h outbox and minimum60s/five-minute passive cadence remain.

Strict server arithmetic/type/enum/size validation, existing committed ACK/deduplication and the independent product worker produce prepared daily network facts. Migration0032 adds bounded facts and an indexed selected-failure lookup.

Studio Network tab reads one prepared GET, filters category/platform/build/device/OS and shows separate timing, observed failures, retries, throttling, transfer bodies, upload-age coverage and received request IDs. Samples are unverified client hints and never game or uptime authority.

initial_test_diagnostics: Initial mocked timing assertion used frame timers that advanced faster than monotonic wall time in headless fixtures. Switched the fixture waits to the measured monotonic clock; timing assertion retained and passed.
Initial actual HTTP fixture had no durable queue path, so it could not qualify records for upload. Added a task-owned queue path; assertions retained and actual ingress/ACK then passed.
Initial desktop table required horizontal scrolling; scoped table wrapping now shows all timing columns and the browser checks it.
remaining_acceptance: Authorized backend migration/deployment of0032 and a fresh app build/install remain. No production deployment, live backend writes, APK export/install or physical-device test occurred.

Only observed signed-in API transmissions are measured. Startup guest sign-in, other SDK traffic, telemetry transport, DNS/TLS subphase timings, verified service uptime and complete delivery are unavailable.

RAM data is best effort. Repeated-operation counts are observed within the recent process-local key cache, not a lifetime retry total. Late menu snapshots report their collection day and may span earlier request times.
Selected failure reports read at most201 indexed candidates and return at most50 scoped samples. Limits and truncation are explicit; request IDs must be corroborated with backend logs.
Canonical handling/scoring and existing session/recovery work are preserved. No full game regression or physical network/radio/thermal benchmark is claimed.
